title: From Goat Kids to the Hillside Herd
caption:
GOAT KIDS, HILLSIDES AND QUIET MOMENTS. New story, original edit, real source credits. #WildVox #Goats #AnimalLife

narration_timeline.text: Newborn goat kids stand beside an adult, exploring the world just a few steps away.
narration_timeline.scene: Authentic newborn kids beside adult; no nursing claim

narration_timeline.text: On another hillside, older goats spread across the grass and move at different speeds.
narration_timeline.scene: Managed goat herd grazing on Sunnyvale hillside

narration_timeline.text: A separate herd carefully crosses rough and rocky ground, finding its footing.
narration_timeline.scene: Real moving goats on rocky ground

narration_timeline.text: Some goats stop for hay, while a different goat rests on an open grassy patch.
narration_timeline.scene: Separate hay feeding and resting goat

narration_timeline.text: In a pen, other goats pause and groom themselves between their daily activities.
narration_timeline.scene: Real goats in pen and independently filmed genuine self-grooming; never assert yawning

narration_timeline.text: One last goat stands outside, a quiet ending to these different moments of herd life.
